title: A Gamma envelope and sharp moment inequalities for Gaussian quadratic forms
summary: We study extremal absolute central moments of Gaussian quadratic forms under a fixed Frobenius norm. For a nonzero real symmetric matrix $M$ and $G\sim N(0,I_n)$, we construct an explicit centered difference of Gamma variables with the same mean, variance, and third centered moment as $G^{\mathsf T}MG-\operatorname{tr}M$. After normalization, replacing the quadratic form by this Gamma difference does not decrease $\mathbb{E} f$ for every $C^2$ test function $f$ such that $f''$ is convex and $f$, $f'$, and $f''$ have polynomial growth.
